title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: assign Anthropic model access to specific users and groups
summary: Hold: the retention description omits Microsoft's warning that flagged content can be retained for two years and classification scores for seven years. The default field describes model availability rather than the new access control, and the briefing overlooks documented error messages for unassigned users.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes admin controls for managing Anthropic as a provider for specific users and groups.
claims.quote: This feature introduces admin controls for managing Anthropic as a model provider for specific users and groups in the tenant.

claims.claim: The printed Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic > Choose who can access Anthropic models for Copilot and generative AI experiences path reaches user and group selection.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Open questions
claims.claim: No Graph or PowerShell operation for assigning Anthropic access to users and groups is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic AI provider users security groups Microsoft Graph PowerShell assign access disable subprocessor copilotAdminSetting API. Opened provider-access, connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilotAdminSetting references; none documents an assignment operation.

claims.claim: No automation operation for disabling Anthropic as a Microsoft subprocessor is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic AI provider users security groups Microsoft Graph PowerShell assign access disable subprocessor copilotAdminSetting API. Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and copilotAdminSetting; results describe UI disabling, not an automation operation.

claims.where: controls[].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Changing these Microsoft 365 settings requires AI Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be a member of the AI Administrator or Global Administrator role to perform this task.

claims.claim: The new user and group access control is on by default.
claims.quote: Searched: AI provider user group assignments Anthropic access restriction default all users Microsoft Copilot. Opened assignment and both Anthropic setting pages; they state regional model availability, not that the new assignment control starts enforcing by default.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to unknown for this new control. State: 'Microsoft documents regional defaults for Claude model availability, but does not state the new assignment control's default enforcement state.' Keep the separately attributed regional availability facts.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Scope; controls[1].note; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models are on by default for most commercial customers outside EU/EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: Microsoft enables Claude models on by default for most customers in commercial cloud (excluding EU/EFTA and UK).

claims.claim: Claude models are disabled by default in EU/EFTA and UK.
claims.quote: Customers within the EU Data Boundary and customers in the UK have Claude models disabled by default.
claims.fix: After this attributed general default, add: 'The separate apps-only article says its setting is enabled by default for EU/EFTA/UK tenants created after March 25, 2026, so check the tenant's actual selection.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/copilot-anthropic-apps.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Claude models in Microsoft offerings are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn says Claude models are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.
claims.quote: Claude models from Anthropic are coming into the EU Data Boundary starting in December 2026.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions; changes
claims.claim: Setting option names and some selections change on December 9, 2026.
claims.quote: If the All users for Microsoft 365 apps only option is currently selected, the selection will change to the All users option. If you haven't previously made any selection, your selection will change to All users.
claims.fix: Replace 'options are renamed and some selections change' with: 'For EU/EFTA/UK tenants, All users for Microsoft 365 apps only is removed on December 9, 2026; that selection and no previous selection change to All users. Other selections, including No users, remain unchanged.'

claims.claim: Microsoft Product Terms and DPA govern Claude use where Anthropic is a Microsoft subprocessor rather than a Data Retention independent processor.
claims.quote: Unless models are labeled "Anthropic models with Data Retention," the Microsoft Product Terms and Microsoft Data Protection Addendum (DPA) apply

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention operate under Anthropic's own terms.
claims.quote: Anthropic acts as an independent processor and use of Anthropic models with Data Retention is subject to acceptance of Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service and Anthropic's Data Protection Addendum.

claims.claim: Anthropic stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days, with no longer-retention qualification given.
claims.quote: If Anthropic's trust and safety classifiers identify potential violations of Anthropic's Usage Policy, Anthropic may retain content (inputs and outputs) for up to two years and trust and safety classification scores for up to seven years.
claims.fix: Append to the 30-day statement: 'If Anthropic's trust and safety classifiers identify potential Usage Policy violations, content may be retained for up to two years and trust and safety classification scores for up to seven years.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Data Retention models are off for all scenarios until a tenant admin explicitly opts in.
claims.quote: No users will have access to these models until the tenant admin explicitly opts in to enable use of Anthropic models with Data Retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The tenant admin must separately choose all or specific users or groups for Data Retention models.
claims.quote: The tenant admin must also choose which users (all or specific users or groups) can access and use these models.

claims.claim: The administrator can enable Claude again later.
claims.quote: You can choose to enable Claude models at a later date if desired.
